acceptance: Release verification command reproduces every digest and trust check, installed Mac/Windows vector-dispatch receipts, and sealed versus legacy-unsealed event-history status.
verifiedBy: node --test scripts/release/evidence/sbom.test.mjs scripts/release/evidence/manifest.test.mjs (14/14 pass, executed -- see commands.log). node scripts/qualification/run.mjs --task MBR-807 (the manifest command) was not run; per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md the manifest commands list runs once at the final phased book gate, not per task.
observed: The pre-existing scripts/release/verify-release-evidence.mjs (commit 98233f35, not modified) already IS the release verification command that recomputes every digest and trust check for an orthic.membrane.release-evidence.v1 manifest -- source/SBOM/provenance/toolchain/test/compatibility file hashes, ed25519 + apple-notary/windows-authenticode signature identities, both installed macOS and Windows vector-dispatch receipts (via MBR-806's verify-platform-artifacts.mjs), and an explicit sealed/legacy-unsealed event-history status. This task adds the generator/binder that produces real content for that manifest: scripts/release/evidence/sbom.mjs derives a real SBOM (499 components: 28 npm + 471 cargo, zero gaps) from this repository's real apps/membrane-hub/pnpm-lock.yaml and apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/Cargo.lock -- the exact dependency graphs compiled into the shipped membrane-hub artifact -- with no fabricated component, checksum, or license (unresolvable entries are reported as named `gaps`, tested explicitly). scripts/release/evidence/manifest.mjs's buildReleaseGenerationEvidence() reads MBR-903's evidence/releases/<releaseId>/release-generation.json as the sole source of release identity and binds its exact release_generation digest into this task's manifest (proven via a test that recomputes that same digest independently through scripts/release/pipeline/identity.mjs's own computeReleaseGeneration, imported unmodified, and asserts byte-equality) -- it never recomputes a second, parallel identity. Its assembleReleaseEvidenceManifest() composes the final manifest once every required piece exists; a test proves the pre-existing, unmodified verifyReleaseEvidence() accepts a manifest assembled this way (verified: true) for a manifest keyed to that same real release_generation digest.
gap: This task ships the SBOM generator and the release-generation-binding evidence layer, plus proof (via tests) that a complete manifest built this way is accepted by the pre-existing verifier and correctly bound to MBR-903's real identity. It does not itself produce a REAL, complete, verifier-passing manifest for an actual release today, because that requires artifacts/receipts this task's hard rules forbid producing: (1) a sealed, commit-matching, verified macOS/Windows artifact -- requires running `pnpm --dir apps/membrane-hub release:doctor` then `release:build:mac`/`release:build:win` (MBR-901/MBR-902, explicitly forbidden here); (2) real test receipts -- requires a full test run, not performed by this task (only this task's own two new test files were run); (3) an ed25519 signature and apple-notary/windows-authenticode trust receipt -- requires real signing, not performed by this task; (4) installed macOS and Windows vector-dispatch acceptance receipts (MBR-806) -- not produced by this task; (5) an explicit sealed-vs-legacy-unsealed event-history receipt -- not produced by this task. buildReleaseGenerationEvidence() reports every one of these honestly as a named `gaps` entry with `status: 'incomplete'` rather than fabricating any of them (see docs/release/evidence.md and evidence/productization/MBR-807/summary.json for the full list). This is deferred to the Book 3 final phased gate, consistent with MBR-901/MBR-902/MBR-903's own acceptance.json gap notes.
